about.heading: Software developer building useful systems
paragraphs: I am a software developer with experience across web applications, internal systems, applied machine learning, and technical support. I care about clarity, usability, and code that stays maintainable after the first release.

At the moment I am focused on software development at National Housing Corporation, including work on the NHC website and the recruitment portal. Long term, I want to grow further into AI, data science, and computer science work.

skills.heading: Tools and technologies I use across the stack.

items.org: National Housing Corporation (NHC) - Internship, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
bullets: Developed and maintained internal web applications for staff workflows, reporting, and service delivery.
Worked on public and internal systems, including the NHC website and the recruitment portal.
Designed database structures and improved SQL queries for faster record retrieval.
Collaborated with finance, administration, and IT teams to translate requirements into usable software.

items.org: Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA) - Internship, Arusha, Tanzania
bullets: Supported internal systems and helped test data management modules used by revenue officers.
Resolved hardware and software issues across multiple workstations to reduce downtime.
Documented processes and user guides to support non-technical staff.
Built a lung cancer prediction system using Python and machine learning.
Created a pharmacy inventory system with real-time stock tracking and alerts.
Presented prototypes and technical documentation to supervisors.
